fields.Name: T168 - Entity Form View Email Template
fields.Description: Verifies an Email Template record opens from the grid into its full record form with populated subject and body content.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Email Templates' entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Email Templates' and click the exact node), or navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Email%20Templates. When the grid loads, click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'. Verify the full record form displays with populated detail fields such as Subject, From Name, From Email, and Preview Text. (NOTE: the email body/content is stored in a related 'Template Contents' section, not as a direct field on this form — you do NOT need to find a 'body' field; seeing the populated metadata fields is success.) Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: An Email Template full record form is open (not just the grid/preview panel)
The form shows populated detail fields such as Subject, From Name/Email, and Preview Text (the body/content lives in a related Template Contents section, not a direct field)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
